records.method: Explicit user requirements override platform syntax, selected cinematography/style profiles, continuity defaults, and package defaults.
records.caution: Platform syntax cannot override world facts.

records.method: Start from one meaningful creative spark and disclose important assumptions instead of asking a long questionnaire.
records.conditions: No mutually exclusive world direction is unresolved.
records.caution: Ask when the missing choice would change the core world.

records.method: Lock geography, climate, era/technology, inhabitants, body covering, materials, architecture, tools/transport, ecology, symbols, palette, lighting, atmosphere, texture, and forbidden drift before prompts.
records.caution: Keep entries visual and generative, not lore paragraphs.

records.method: Separate visible reference evidence, strong implication, creative extension, and unknowns.
records.caution: Do not claim unsupported cultural facts or copy the source composition.

records.method: Plan aspect, narrative question, action, three depth planes, continuity anchors, camera position, distance, view intent, light/weather, intensity, and before/after trace for each frame.
records.conditions: Before drafting a multi-frame prompt set.
records.caution: The matrix is internal unless planning-only output is requested.

records.method: Use at least three continuity anchors per frame.
records.conditions: Useful for dense world boards or drift-prone generators.
records.caution: Allow fewer in intentionally sparse frames if same-world identity remains provable.

records.method: Avoid using the same focal-length band more than three times in a nine-frame set.
records.conditions: Only when unwanted visual sameness is the diagnosed problem.
records.caution: Do not enforce when a uniform lens system is intentional; narrative function outranks the quota.

records.method: Include at least two quiet frames and one high-pressure frame in a nine-frame set.
records.conditions: Useful as an anti-monotony diagnostic for a full board.
records.caution: Do not manufacture pressure or quietness when the world premise does not support it.

records.method: Treat camera position, height, distance, field of view, depth-of-field intent, lens character, medium/emulation, framing, and motion trace as replaceable fields.
records.conditions: When camera or style specificity changes the image.
records.caution: Do not prepend a fixed camera-brand string.

records.method: Perspective follows camera position and distance; focal length controls field of view; depth of field has multiple variables.
records.caution: Prompt parameters express intent and do not prove physical execution.

records.method: Use pores, peach fuzz, and facial imperfections only when a human face is near and resolvable.
records.caution: Skip distant, hidden, masked, non-human, silhouette, or stylized subjects.

records.method: Default to world concept, continuity anchors, visual intention, and one complete prompt per aspect.
records.caution: Do not duplicate camera and lighting when already embedded.

records.method: Provide separated bilingual camera, lighting, and prompts only on explicit production request.
records.conditions: Full bilingual prompt pack or production controls requested.
records.caution: Show platform parameters only once if duplicate copies would create extra jobs.

records.method: Stop at concept, continuity bible, aspect matrix, and open decisions before final prompts.
records.conditions: Visual development direction is not yet approved.
records.caution: Do not silently continue to platform prompts.

records.method: V11 source snapshot for parameter ordering, aspect ratio, style reference/profile, HD, stylize, permutations, and exclusions.
records.caution: Reverify all syntax, version, compatibility, resolution, and multi-job behavior before use.

records.method: Natural-language scene and exclusions; no Midjourney syntax leakage.
records.conditions: User explicitly requests Nano Banana output.
records.caution: Verify current product surface and settings before execution.

records.method: Use direct natural-language composition, action, continuity, light, material, and compact exclusions.
records.caution: Current product parameters belong to the active executor/adapter.

records.method: Use inhabitants, animals, architecture, landscape, daily life, migration/transport, sound/culture, power/pressure, and intimate portrait as distinct narrative functions.
records.caution: User or upstream-selected subset/count overrides the full nine.
